description: Germany only. Checks a German job ad (Stellenanzeige) for discrimination traps under the AGG (Allgemeines Gleichbehandlungsgesetz), Germany only. Use it before a founder publishes a job ad or after you drafted one: pass the ad text. Returns each risky word with the protected characteristic (Merkmal), the reason and a better wording, plus the parts of a good ad; the text itself is neither stored nor returned.

anzeigentext.description: Full text of the job ad, at most 3000 characters, without names or contact details

name: stellenanzeige_check
title: Stellenanzeige: AGG-Check
